description: This file defines the DbStoredQueries class, which encapsulates stored queries for Orleans' relational storage backend. It includes logic for loading query templates, parsing database records into Orleans entities, and managing query parameters for various Orleans components such as membership, reminders, streams, and grain directory.

classes.name: DbStoredQueries
classes.description: Provides stored SQL query templates and parsing utilities for Orleans storage operations, including queries for membership, reminders, streaming, and grain directory components.

methods.description: Constructor that validates presence of all required query keys in the provided dictionary.
